title: Thawscope: a word puzzle where every guess shows which way is warmer

meta.description: Thawscope is an offline word puzzle for iPhone. Type any word: the closer its meaning to the frozen word, the hotter it lands on a thermal scope, and warm guesses thaw the letters. 120 free levels, a Daily Core, no ads, no tracking.
meta.og:title: Thawscope: every guess shows which way is warmer
meta.og:description: A frozen word sits at the centre of a thermal scope. Type a word, read how hot it lands and which way it points, and thaw the letters. Coming soon to the App Store.
meta.og:image:alt: The Thawscope icon, a cracked ice core under a thermal arc, beside a level in play: probes such as sweet 70° and sugar 84° placed around a half-thawed word.
